title: Range against launch angle
brief: Plots: line chart with markers, range in metres against launch angle, for u = 20 m/s with no air resistance, at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 degrees, values 0.0, 20.4, 35.3, 40.8, 35.3, 20.4, 0.0
html:
<script>
const u = 20.0, g = 9.8;
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 90], y: [0, 45], xLabel: "Launch angle (degrees)", yLabel: "Range (m)" });
const R = a => u * u * Math.sin(2 * a * Math.PI / 180) / g;
const data = [[0, 0.0], [15, 20.4], [30, 35.3], [45, 40.8], [60, 35.3], [75, 20.4], [90, 0.0]];
let angle = 0;

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  c.fn(x => R(x), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  const r = R(angle);
  c.vline(angle, `${angle}°`);
  c.dots([[angle, r]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  c.label(angle, r, `${r.toFixed(1)} m`);
  c.readout([
    `Launch angle = ${angle}°`,
    `Range = ${r.toFixed(1)} m`,
    `Max at 45°: 40.8 m`
  ]);

  let msg;
  if (Math.abs(angle) < 0.5) {
    msg = "Zero, because the ball just rolls along the ground and never flies.";
  } else if (Math.abs(angle - 90) < 0.5) {
    msg = "Also zero, because the ball goes straight up and comes straight back down to the same spot.";
  } else if (Math.abs(angle - 30) < 0.5) {
    msg = "Now look at 30 degrees. Let's check it: 35.3 metres.";
  } else if (Math.abs(angle - 60) < 0.5) {
    msg = "Now 60 degrees: also 35.3 metres.";
  } else {
    msg = `At ${angle.toFixed(1)}°, R = u² sin 2θ / g = ${r.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  }
  Visual.state(`Launch angle ${angle.toFixed(1)}° with u = 20 m/s gives range ${r.toFixed(1)} m. ${msg}`);
}

Visual.on("angle", v => { angle = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
